pull: Clue: Churchill called her The Beast
photoNote: Tirpitz in Bogen Bay, Ofotfjord, near Narvik, about 1943 to 1944. NHHC NH 71390, public domain. Photo file not yet in the repo: the card was rendered in the browser and uploaded straight to Typefully.
photoCredit: Tirpitz in Bogen Bay, Norway, 1943 to 1944. NHHC NH 71390, public domain.
body:
Can you name this ship?

On 18 October 1944, an RAF reconnaissance plane photographed her at anchor off Tromsø in Norway. By then the British had been trying to sink her for nearly three years.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
